name: iimjobs-jobs-scraper
title: iimjobs Jobs Scraper: MBA and Management Jobs in India
description: Scrape management and MBA job postings from iimjobs.com, India's job board for experienced professionals. Returns title, company, locations, experience, salary, tags, full description, recruiter and applicant counts. Pay per result.
readme:
# iimjobs Jobs Scraper: MBA and Management Jobs in India Get job postings from [iimjobs.com](https://www.iimjobs.com/), India's job board for MBAs and experienced professionals, as clean dataset rows. Search by keyword and get the title, company, locations, experience range, salary when shown, tags, the full description, the company profile and the recruiter. ## What you can do with it - Build a list of companies that hire for a management function (product, finance, consulting, marketing, operations) in India. - Track the market over time: run it on a schedule and watch new postings, locations, experience bands and applicant counts. - Feed a job board, alert service or salary research with current postings. - Find recruiters and agencies that post for several companies. ## What you get One dataset row per job. A job found by several keywords or on overlapping pages is returned once, and duplicates are removed before anything is charged, so the number of rows is the number of results you pay for. | Field | Description | |-------|-------------| | `id`, `title`, `designation` | Job id (the dedup key), title and role designation | | `job_url`, `apply_url`, `apply_external` | Job page on iimjobs.com and the link to apply. `apply_external` is `true` when `apply_url` is an external apply link from the employer. Most jobs on iimjobs are applied for on the site itself; apply_url then points to the job page and apply_external is false. | | `company`, `company_name`, `company_id`, `company_logo_url`, `company_domain`, `job_company_id`, `company_career_slug` | The hiring company. `company_name` has the same value as `company`. `job_company_id` is set when an agency posts for another company | | `company_rating`, `company_review_count`, `company_ambitionbox_url` | Employee rating and number of reviews on AmbitionBox | | `company_about`, `company_founded_year`, `company_employees`, `company_type`, `company_primary_industry`, `company_nature_of_business`, `company_hq`, `company_office_locations`, `company_benefits`, `company_clusters`, `company_sub_clusters` | Company profile | | `location`, `locations`, `location_group` | Job locations as text and as a list, and the location label iimjobs shows | | `experience_min`, `experience_max` | Years of experience asked | | `salary_min`, `salary_max`, `salary_currency`, `salary_period`, `salary_hidden` | Salary, only when the poster shows it. Amounts are in lakh INR per year (LPA) as iimjobs lists them. `salary_hidden` is true when the poster hides the salary. Nothing is estimated | | `tags`, `industry_ids`, `preferred_industries`, `functional_area_id`, `category_id` | Skill and function tags, and the iimjobs ids for industry, function and category | | `work_from_home`, `female_candidates`, `differently_abled`, `ex_defence`, `female_returners` | Flags the poster sets: remote work and open to women, differently abled, ex-defence or women returning to work | | `confidential`, `premium`, `branded_jd`, `star`, `is_active`, `is_expired` | Posting flags | | `applicants`, `views`, `recruiter_actions` | Counts the site shows | | `recruiter_id`, `recruiter_name`, `recruiter_designation`, `recruiter_profile_pic_url`, `recruiter_first_response_time` | The recruiter as shown on the posting. A value iimjobs masks is null | | `description`, `description_text` | Full description as HTML and as plain text | | `posted_at`, `posted_date` | Posting time (ISO 8601, UTC) and posting date in India | | `ref_code` | Reference code of the search result | | `details_fetched` | `true` when the detail record was read for the row | | `search_query`, `source`, `scraped_at` | Keyword that found the job, site, scrape time (UTC) | Fields marked "needs the detail record" in the dataset view (description, company profile, `company_career_slug`, `is_active`, `is_expired`, `recruiter_first_response_time`) are empty when `includeDetails` is off. Company profile fields are also empty for companies that have no AmbitionBox profile. Arrays are always arrays (`[]` when empty). Fields the site never filled in the sampled postings are not part of the output. ## Input | Field | Type | Description | |---|---|---| | `searchQueries` | string[] | Keywords, one search each (default `product manager`) | | `includeDetails` | boolean | Read the detail record of each job for the description, company profile and recruiter (default `true`) | | `maxResultsPerQuery` | integer | Cap per keyword, 1 to 1000 (default 50) | | `maxResults` | integer | Total cap across all keywords (0 = no limit) | Without any keyword the actor runs the sample search for 20 rows. ### Example ```json {"searchQueries": ["product manager"], "includeDetails": true, "maxResults": 20} ``` ## Sample output ```json { "id": "1742187", "title": "Paytm - Product Manager", "designation": "Product Manager", "job_url": "https://www.iimjobs.com/j/paytm-product-manager-1742187", "apply_url": "https://www.iimjobs.com/j/paytm-product-manager-1742187", "apply_external": false, "company": "Paytm", "company_name": "Paytm", "company_id": 357, "company_logo_url": "https://rec-assets.iimjobs.com/CompanyLogos/centralised-79.webp", "company_domain": "paytm.com", "job_company_id": null, "company_career_slug": "paytm", "company_rating": 3.2, "company_review_count": 10458, "company_ambitionbox_url": "https://www.ambitionbox.com/reviews/paytm-reviews", "company_about": "

Paytm started the Digital Revolution in India.

And we went on to become India’s leading Payments App. Today, mo...", "company_founded_year": "2010", "company_employees": "10001-50000", "company_type": "Indian MNC", "company_primary_industry": "FinTech", "company_nature_of_business": [ "Product", "Service", "B2C" ], "company_hq": "Noida", "company_office_locations": [ "Noida, Uttar Pradesh", "Mumbai, Maharashtra" ], "company_benefits": [ "Health Insurance", "Learning & Development Support" ], "company_clusters": [ "Financial Services Companies" ], "company_sub_clusters": [ "Top Financial Service Companies", "Fintech Companies" ], "location": "Bangalore", "locations": [ "Bangalore" ], "location_group": "Bangalore", "experience_min": 3, "experience_max": 7, "salary_min": null, "salary_max": null, "salary_currency": null, "salary_period": null, "salary_hidden": true, "tags": [ "IT Product Management", "Online Product Management", "Consumer Internet" ], "industry_ids": [ 33 ], "preferred_industries": [], "functional_area_id": 37, "category_id": 15, "work_from_home": false, "female_candidates": false, "differently_abled": false, "ex_defence": false, "female_returners": false, "confidential": false, "premium": true, "branded_jd": false, "star": false, "is_active": true, "is_expired": false, "applicants": 814, "views": 1319, "recruiter_actions": 0, "recruiter_id": 292499, "recruiter_name": "[removed]", "recruiter_designation": null, "recruiter_profile_pic_url": null, "recruiter_first_response_time": 12, "description": "

Job Description:


- 3-5 years of core Product Management experience, specifically within high-growth consumer or partner-facing produ...", "description_text": "Job Description:\n\n- 3-5 years of core Product Management experience, specifically within high-growth consumer or partner-facing product charters.\n\n- Proven trac...", "posted_at": "2026-10-27T08:35:02.862Z", "posted_date": "2026-10-27", "ref_code": "sp_br_prm", "details_fetched": true, "search_query": "product manager", "source": "iimjobs.com", "scraped_at": "2026-11-06T09:00:00Z" } ``` The sample is shortened. Every row has all fields listed above. The recruiter name is replaced by "[removed]" here. Recruiter names are personal data. You are responsible for using the data lawfully, including India's Digital Personal Data Protection Act, the GDPR where it applies, and the terms of the site. ## Pricing (Pay-per-event) Price: $0.001 start fee per run, then $0.0018 per job result ($1.80 per 1,000 jobs). | Event | Description | When it fires | |---|---|---| | `apify-actor-start` | Run start fee | Once per run | | `job-result` | One job row in the dataset | Once per row pushed | Duplicates are never charged. Set a maximum total charge on the run to stop at a budget: the run ends cleanly when it is reached, and the status message says how many jobs were delivered. The pricing box on the actor page always shows the current rates. ## FAQ **How many jobs can one keyword return?** Up to 1000 per keyword (`maxResultsPerQuery`). Results come 20 at a time, in the order the site returns them. For larger sets split the work into narrower keywords. **Why does a row have no description?** The description comes from the detail record. Turn `includeDetails` on (default). If a single detail record cannot be read, the row is still delivered with the search fields and `details_fetched` is `false`. **Why is the salary empty?** Most posters hide the salary on iimjobs. `salary_hidden` tells you; the amount is only set when the poster shows it. **Why do the same ids sometimes show up on two pages?** The site shifts its list while new jobs arrive. The actor removes these repeats before saving and before charging. **What does the run status say when nothing is found?** A keyword with no matching job ends cleanly with "0 jobs found for ...". If the site refuses the requests, the run fails with a clear message and only the start fee is charged. ## Limits - India focused: the board lists jobs for experienced professionals, mostly 3 or more years. - Up to 1000 jobs per keyword. - Searches use the keyword only. Other filters of the site (location, experience, function) are not applied; use more specific keywords. ## Support - **Questions or issues?** Email contact@nanoscrape.com or open a ticket in the Issues tab on the actor page. - **Need a scraper for a job board we don't cover yet?** Email contact@nanoscrape.com with the target site and your rough usage volume. --- *Built by [NanoScrape](https://apify.com/nanoscrape). No affiliation with iimjobs.com.*
